evidence.observation: Tube pressure drifting monotonically upward during growth: 3.00 → 3.34 Torr over k=20–24, whereas earlier stages were stable near 2.97
Temperature holds setpoint 750 °C with stable heater power ~45%
Ar flow steady at ~100 sccm, so the pressure rise is not from the MFC
Exhaust O2 sensor not installed; atmosphere purity cannot be verified

args.missing_evidence: An exhaust O2 (or leak-check) measurement to distinguish an air in-leak from a partial exhaust/downstream restriction; e.g. a pump-down or Ar-step test watching pressure response.
